name: Cart checkout
oneLiner: a glass cart card turns in, product tiles drop into it one by one and the subtotal and total add each price as it lands, a pointer presses Checkout, a progress fill runs across the button and it turns green to Order confirmed with a ring, the heading becoming the order number and a green Paid chip
say: when the speaker says people bought the bundle or walks through what goes in the basket ('they add the kit, the templates, the call, and check out'): items land as they are named, the button goes green on 'bought'
